source_snapshot.purpose_facts: With a BMC UART console connected and the host OS idle, invoke `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_off`, confirm the system power is off, power it on again and verify normal operation.
procedure_facts: Check that the system is idle under the host OS.
Check that system power is off.
Power on the system and verify normal operation.
criteria_facts: The command should be sent successfully.
The system should shut down and should be able to reboot after power-on.
Collect results/photos and check post-test logs for unexpected events.
source_conflicts: The source requires a BMC UART console but does not explicitly state which shell owns `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh`; V2 and DeepSeek relocate it to host SSH without source evidence.
The phrase `system could reboot` is ambiguous; the procedure explicitly requires a separate power-on step, so it cannot be assumed to auto-reboot after `power_off`.
No off-state timeout, approved power-on method, boot timeout or normal-operation health matrix is supplied.
missing_source_information: Signed execution location and `powerctrl.sh` version/hash/help/semantics for `power_off` and any status/on verbs.
Independent power-state observation method and required off-state dwell/timeout.
Approved power-on path, boot timeout and recovery escalation.
Definition of idle, data-durability preparation, normal-operation checks and expected/allowed power-event logs.
Whether UART connection is pre-installed or requires a physical manual action.

original_test_intent.statement: Exercise one intentional immediate GPIO-based system power-off through the platform's `powerctrl.sh` control path, prove the host reaches the off state, power it back on through an approved independent path and prove normal post-boot operation.
must_preserve: Immediate GPIO power-off rather than graceful OS shutdown.
BMC UART/OOB observability and host-OS idle precondition.
Exact `power_off` operation after its execution context is verified.
Independent confirmation of the off state before power-on.
A separate power-on/reboot and full post-boot health check.
One shutdown/power-on cycle and 15/15-minute planning estimates.
must_not_infer: That the command runs in the host OS merely because a host SSH example exists in prior review.
That SSH loss proves system power is off.
That `power_status` can reliably execute after a host-side shell has powered off its own system.
That the system automatically reboots after `power_off`.
That command acceptance alone proves GPIO actuation, off state or recovery.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly classifies the case as approval-gated rather than BLOCKED and requires an idle dedicated SUT, independent observation/recovery and post-boot health evidence.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 changes the control plane to host SSH and embeds `power_off; sleep 5; power_status` in one remote shell even though the source starts with a BMC UART console. If the command truly runs on the host, shutdown terminates the shell before status; if it belongs on the BMC, the V2 target is wrong. This must be resolved, not guessed.

related_records: No prior record supplies this platform's vendor script semantics or authorizes substituting Redfish/IPMI for the GPIO path.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The source's BMC UART instruction and exact vendor command outrank DeepSeek/V2's invented host-SSH wrapper. V3 keeps the valid approval classification but requires a signed execution-location handoff and distinct control, observation and recovery channels.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep the approval-gated classification and critical safeguards, but remove V2's unsupported host-SSH wrapper. The case becomes executable only after the vendor script's BMC/host location and semantics are proven, with independent off-state observation and a separately approved power-on path; UART attachment or recovery may remain manual.

conditions_present: The exact destructive intent, vendor power-off verb, idle precondition, BMC UART requirement, off-state checkpoint, recovery intent and single-cycle structure are present.
missing: Execution location, script provenance/semantics, idle definition, off/on observation and timeouts, power-on method, expected power events, post-boot health matrix and recovery ownership.
provider: BMC/platform owner supplies the signed `powerctrl.sh` location/version, GPIO semantics, status method and expected logs.
Lab owner supplies UART/OOB/PDU access, maintenance approval, off/on timeouts and recovery.
OS/workload owner defines idle/data-protection and post-boot service/device checks.
safe_read_only_work: Record SUT, BMC, board and firmware identity; verify BMC UART/OOB reachability and independent power-state telemetry.
On the signed execution environment, inspect script path, owner, hash/version and read-only help or package metadata without invoking a power action.
Inventory workloads, mounts, storage health, device topology, services, logs and current power state without clearing evidence.
prohibited_until_resolved: Invoking `power_off`, guessing host versus BMC execution, using the V2 chained SSH command, graceful-shutdown substitution, unapproved power-on/reset, repeated cycles, log clearing, production use or PASS.
closure_evidence: Owner-signed evidence identifies the exact shell and confirms `power_off` performs the intended immediate GPIO transition.
Independent off-state observation, one approved power-on method, timeouts and escalation are demonstrated before the destructive step.
Idle/data-protection, expected power-event logs and post-boot health acceptance are recorded and approved.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify Immediate GPIO Power-Off and Controlled System Recovery
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that the platform's approved GPIO control path performs one immediate host power-off, that an independent management channel observes the host in the off state, and that a separately authorized power-on returns the complete system to its required healthy operating state.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Only the SUT/BMC/board/firmware combination for which the owner validates `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_off` and its GPIO semantics. The control command runs in the signed BMC or platform-management shell identified by the recipe; host OS access is used to prove idle and post-boot health, not assumed to own the script.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One whole-SUT immediate power-off and one subsequent power-on/recovery cycle. Scope includes BMC/UART/OOB observation, host power state, boot, storage/device/service health and expected power-event logs. It excludes graceful shutdown, repeated reliability cycling, firmware reset and substitution with another power action unless the test owner revises the case. Treat 15/15 minutes as estimates.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: SUT/BMC/board/firmware identity; signed `powerctrl.sh` execution location, hash/version and `power_off` semantics; GPIO target; protected credentials; BMC UART/OOB/PDU observation; host idle/data-durability checklist; approved disruptive window; off-state and boot timeouts; separate power-on command or manual procedure; expected SEL/power-event rules; post-boot device/storage/network/GPU/service checks; UART attachment status; abort/escalation and recovery owner.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Before the cycle, preserve logs and prove the SUT is the approved idle target with no production workload or unresolved storage activity; prove BMC UART/OOB and the power-on path independently. From the signed management shell, start timestamped UART/OOB capture and invoke exactly `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_off` once. Do not append status commands in a host SSH shell. Observe the host power state from the still-live independent channel until the approved off timeout and record the off dwell. Then perform exactly one approved power-on action, observe POST/boot, and verify BMC, OS, storage/filesystems, expected devices, network/GPU where applicable, services and logs against the signed matrix.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated non-production SUT; exact target identity; no active jobs/users/updates; owner-approved idle and data-durability state; script provenance and execution shell verified; UART/OOB/status and separate power-on path tested read-only; baseline health/logs preserved; credentials, evidence capture, off/boot timeouts and recovery personnel ready; explicit approval immediately before power-off.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware identity; script path/hash/version, execution shell and owner semantics; approval and idle/data-protection checklist; workload/mount/storage/device/service baseline; UART/OOB transcript with timestamps; exact power-off command and its last observable output; independent power-state transition to Off within timeout and dwell; separate power-on actor/action/time; POST and boot timeline; restored BMC/OS access; filesystem/storage/device/network/GPU/service health as applicable; SEL/journal/dmesg power-event comparison; no unexpected recovery; engineer disposition.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The signed platform GPIO power-control recipe and script semantics, approved off/on timeouts, expected power-event rules and post-boot health matrix. Pass requires the exact immediate GPIO path, independently proven Off state, one successful authorized power-on and all required health checks; command submission, UART output or session loss alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not run on production, guess the script's shell, substitute graceful shutdown, chain post-off status behind a host session, infer Off from lost SSH, clear logs before preservation, power on before Off is confirmed, repeat automatically or proceed without an independent recovery channel. Stop on target mismatch, active workload/storage activity, script drift, BMC/UART/OOB loss, unexpected power state, timeout, repeated transition, smoke/thermal/power alarm, failed POST/boot, storage corruption, missing device/service or unexpected critical log.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Platform/BMC owner approves script identity, GPIO semantics and expected events; OS/workload owner confirms idle/data protection; lab owner approves the disruptive window, target and recovery; a human authorizes the single power-off immediately before execution and the separate power-on after Off is observed; engineer judges PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED and any recovery or rerun.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: A human may need to attach/verify the BMC UART and perform the approved power-on or emergency recovery. After those prerequisites, an Agent may collect baselines, invoke the single approved management-shell command, observe independent telemetry and execute post-boot checks; it may not self-authorize the destructive transition or retry.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: If Off is not reached within timeout, preserve control/UART/OOB evidence and stop; do not send another destructive command. If power-on, POST or boot fails, stop further cycling and invoke the platform owner's BMC/PDU/service procedure. For filesystem, storage, device or service degradation, preserve logs and use the relevant owner recovery before any retest.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Execution shell/script/GPIO target is unverified; target or firmware mismatches; SUT is not idle; data-protection checklist, approval, UART/OOB observation, off/on timeout, separate power-on path or recovery is absent; baseline is unhealthy; Off cannot be independently proven; an unexpected transition/alarm occurs; power-on/POST/boot times out; required devices/filesystems/services fail; critical unexpected logs appear; or final health is not restored.

identified_defects: V2 assumes host-SSH execution despite the source's BMC UART control context.
V2 chains `power_status` after a command that may terminate the host/session, making evidence sequencing unreliable.
The source does not define whether `system could reboot` means a separate power-on or automatic reboot; its explicit step 5 favors separate recovery.
Script provenance, off/on timeouts and normal-operation acceptance are missing.
Session loss is not independent proof of electrical/system Off state.
reason_for_change: Keep V2's correct approval classification while restoring the likely BMC management control plane indicated by the source, eliminating an unreliable host-SSH command chain, and separating command issuance, independent Off observation and later power-on recovery.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Specification DSP0266
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Independent management-plane observation or recovery only when the target BMC exposes the corresponding resource/action
new_technical_evidence.supports: ComputerSystem power actions and supported ResetType values are discovered from the service; a management action must use the target's advertised semantics rather than an assumed universal command. Redfish can provide an independent control/observation option but does not replace the vendor GPIO path without approval.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The source does not state that this BMC implements Redfish power observation or that it is the approved power-on path.

new_technical_evidence.title: Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Platforms exposing Redfish ComputerSystem power state
new_technical_evidence.supports: ForceOff transitions start immediately and successful completion is represented by PowerState Off when supported, illustrating why command acceptance and session loss are distinct from observed final power state.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The vendor `powerctrl.sh` GPIO semantics and platform power-state sensor remain private inputs.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-HW Robust-00024-V002
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Only this immediate GPIO shutdown case
new_technical_evidence.supports: The BMC UART prerequisite, host-idle condition, exact vendor power-off verb, Off checkpoint, separate power-on and normal-operation verification.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: The command shell, power-on method, timeouts and health matrix are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Separates the host OS idle check from the management shell that owns the GPIO script.
Replaces SSH disconnect as evidence with independent observed Off state.
Defines power-on as a distinct authorized step rather than an assumed automatic reboot.
Preserves exactly one cycle and distinguishes control, observation and recovery channels.
resolved_blockers: The test is not BLOCKED merely because it is destructive or may require manual UART/power-on work; the concrete vendor command and recovery intent support gated hybrid execution.
remaining_blockers: Execution awaits signed script location/semantics, independent status and power-on methods, idle/data rules, timeouts, expected logs, health matrix, approval and recovery readiness.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents execution on the wrong node and eliminates a status check placed after a potentially self-terminating host command, while preserving the exact immediate-shutdown intent and strengthening independent Off/recovery evidence without adding extra cycles.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The contract-only validator placed the command in the signed management shell rather than host SSH, preserved exactly one power-off/on cycle, required independent Off proof before separately authorized power-on, and rejected session loss or partial recovery as completion. Missing script semantics, target, timeouts, dwell and health matrix were correctly left to platform handoff.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Reliability row 146 begins with BMC UART, checks host idle, invokes `/usr/bin/powerctrl.sh power_off`, proves Off, then separately powers on and checks normal operation once.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 keeps the right approval classification but invents a host-SSH wrapper whose post-off status command may never run and whose execution location conflicts with the source's BMC console context.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow identity, script metadata, idle baseline and independent management checks now; permit exactly one power-off only after the command shell, Off observation, separate power-on and full recovery are proven and a human approves.
